title: The Paradoxes of Arius
english: But the paradoxical opinions of the Arian faction assert that Christ has been made a sinner. As for the fact that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself (2 Corinthians 5:19), they neither hold it in memory nor declare it with the organs of the tongue.

Instead, like terrible informers and accusers who have mutilated the field, they conduct the contest of the accusation. It is necessary, however, to include all the lawful combatants without fail, but not toward deceit, by keeping one part in silence and bringing forward the other part.

For if he is a creature, then he is not begotten; but if he is begotten, then he is not a creature; since it is not possible for the race to turn toward either regarding the same nature. Everything having a beginning receives an end, and everything receiving an end is subject to corruption.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Arian Paradoxes and Omissions
english: But the paradoxical partisans of Arius declare that Christ has been made to commit sin.
As for the fact that God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ (2 Cor 5:19), they neither carry it in their memory nor with the organs of speech.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Malice of Accusers
english: They shout out. But just as wicked informers and accusers, having distorted the field, perform the contest of accusation, it is necessary to include all the lawful combatants without fail in a love of truth, but not toward deceit, some being silenced and others being torn away.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Distinction between Created and Begotten
english: To bring forth. For if [it] is a creature, then it is not begotten; but if [it] is begotten, it is not a creature; since neither [can] the nature turn toward the same [thing] in either way. Everything having a beginning receives an end, and everything receiving an end is subject to decay.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
